newsitem.title: LEBANON: Two pro-Israeli militiamen wounded in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Two pro-Israeli militiamen wounded in Lebanon.

text.p: Two pro-Israeli militiamen were wounded on Monday when guerrillas attacked their outpost in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
They said guerrillas attacked with machinegun fire, rocket-propelled grenades and mortar bombs the outpost of Sidoon, manned by Israel's local militia allies, the South Lebanon Army (SLA).
The outpost is located in Jizzine, a finger of territory officially outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.
Monday's casualties brought to six the number of SLA militiamen wounded in south Lebanon this year. Five Israeli soldiers were killed and 21 wounded in guerrilla attacks over the same period.
In retaliation, the Israeli and SLA artillery fired at areas facing the outpost, the sources added.
There was no immediate report of casualties in the retaliatory shelling.
In Beirut, Hizbollah said its guerrillas set off a roadside bomb near an SLA vehicle driving near the outpost of Sidoon setting it ablaze.
The pro-Iranian guerrillas are fighting Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide south Lebanon occupation zone.
